title: Recruitment
description: Hiring pools and price tiers (= soldier ranks) with hire price, fee per op and attribute range (spec MGT-002..MGT-005, MGT-022, MGT-074). Fees are paid once per op at launch; there are no salaries.
$comment: Named constants. Fields are optional until the content pass fills them with the design placeholders listed in the spec.

pools.description: MGT-002: tiers and candidates per pool, refresh interval, not set

tiers.description: MGT-002 / MGT-003 / MGT-005 / MGT-074, design draft (hire price / fee per op / attribute range) recruit $1,000 / $300 / 20-45; regular $3,000 / $600 / 35-60; veteran $8,000 / $1,200 / 50-75; elite $20,000 / $2,500 / 65-90; attributeRange.max is also the promotion threshold (MGT-074)

feePerOpUsd.description: MGT-005: paid per soldier of this rank when an op launches

priceFormula.description: MGT-003: scaling of the hire price with the average attribute within a tier, not set

attributeDistribution.description: MGT-022: distribution within the tier range, not set

hiredPilotFeePerOpUsd.description: MGT-005 / DAT-028: fee per op of a hired helicopter pilot, not set
